title: Fox Projector in Ruins
description: A white fox with fiery orange tails stands on a decaying spiral staircase inside a ruined theater, projecting a beam of light from a vintage film projector. The beam shows a burning ship, floating film reels, musical notes, and sea creatures against a dark night sky.
prompt: A luminous white fox with multiple flaming orange tails stands on an overgrown spiral staircase inside a crumbling ancient theater at night. The fox holds and operates an old film projector that casts a bright beam of light into the dark sky, displaying a burning wooden ship, floating film reels, musical notes, and stylized fish. Vines and white flowers cover the decaying stone architecture, with broken columns and rubble visible below. Dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
